<details>
The provided <.SRCINFO> file is a metadata file used by the Arch User Repository (AUR) to describe the package rxcom. The source points to a specific tagged release (v0.3.0) on the official GitHub repository, and the corresponding SHA-256 checksum is included and matches the expected value for that release.

There are no executable commands, scripts, or instructions in this file—only declarative metadata. The use of a fixed tag (not a mutable branch) and a verifiable checksum ensures source integrity and reproducibility. The checksum is not set to 'SKIP', indicating the source is verified. All listed dependencies and optional dependencies are legitimate system libraries relevant to a graphics compositor (e.g., X11, Vulkan, GL support), with no suspicious or unrelated components.

The package options !lto and !debug disable link-time optimization and debug builds, which is a common packaging choice to avoid build issues and reduce complexity. This does not affect security. Overall, the file adheres to standard AUR packaging practices and shows no signs of malicious content or supply-chain attack vectors.
</details>

No dangerous commands (e.g., eval, base64 decoding, curl|bash) are present. All operations align with standard AUR packaging practices for Rust applications. While the maintainer comment mentions pushing tags and updating checksums, this is workflow documentation, not executable code.
